text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
As I am right now, I have no right to call 
myself a Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
A Mejiro who learns nothing from defeat is 
no Mejiro at all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
A Mejiro who learns nothing from defeat is 
no Mejiro at all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
choice_data_list: Giving up is true defeat, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Those words sound just like you, 
Trainer-sama~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I am Mejiro Bright. An Umamusume of 
the Mejiro family line.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Without fail, I shall seize victory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you. I have no intention of 
losing to anyone ever again.
choice_data_list: So what will you do then?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...I shall run. I will run, and seize 
victory next time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: As an Umamusume of the Mejiro family...!
